items.title: Automaker Stocks Reverse as Rotation Trade Unwinds: General Motors and Stellantis Fall 4%, Ford Pulls Back
items.summary: Thursday's rotation rally handed automakers a one-day reprieve from months of pressure, but Friday morning that same trade ran straight into reverse, and the order in which Stellantis, GM, and Ford are falling tells the whole story.

items.title: Ford’s Yield Is One of the Loudest in the Market. Is the Payout Actually Safe?
items.summary: Ford's dividend yield screams louder than almost anything else on the market right now, but trailing yield screens are hiding something important about what investors are actually collecting. Before you buy for income, there are two numbers that determine whether this payout survives 2026.

items.title: The Moneymaxxing Crowd Will Love 5 High-Yield Dividend Stocks Under $20
items.summary: Younger investors are rewriting the rules of wealth building, and five overlooked dividend stocks under $20 sit right at the center of that shift. The real question is whether these picks can hold up long enough to matter.

items.title: Ford Motor (F) Cuts F 150 Prices As Undervalued Narrative Faces A Fresh Test
items.summary: Ford Motor (F) just put its 2027 F-150 lineup in the spotlight with updated styling, new tech features, and lower prices on several high-end trims to address truck affordability concerns. Ford Motor shares trade at US$13.61 after a 1-day share price return of 1.95%, with the 30-day share price return down 2.30% and the 90-day share price return down 3.20%. At the same time, the 1-year total shareholder return of 21.33% and 3-year total shareholder return of 34.72% point to longer term gains...

items.title: The Under-the-Radar Stock Big Money Is Quietly Buying Up
items.summary: Institutional investors have long been interested in Ford's lucrative dividend, but now there could be new reasons for Wall Street's interest in Ford.

items.title: Ford Hasn’t Raised Its Dividend in Years. Don’t Count on a Hike in 2026.
items.summary: Ford hasn't raised its dividend since 2022, even though it has topped up the regular dividend with a supplemental dividend. The company might not increase its payout this year, despite the expected increase in free cash flow.
